objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Exploit the insecure direct object reference weakness of a Flask application that keeps the logged-in user name in an AES-CBC encrypted cookie and recover the flag (FLAG{...}) it guards.
hints: Note every numeric or encoded identifier the application sends, and whether the server checks that it belongs to you.
Look at what the server reveals when it fails to decrypt or verify a value you sent.

steps.title: Identify the stack
steps.prompt: Which framework or language runs the application? (name only)

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which access-control weakness lets you reach another account's objects by changing an identifier?

steps.title: Name the attack
steps.prompt: Which attack changes CBC plaintext by altering the previous ciphertext block?

steps.title: Name the second weakness
steps.prompt: Which kind of weakness does the challenge revolve around?
